title: Skill Activator for Explicit Workflow Requests
summary: Ships a UserPromptSubmit hook (the skill activator) that detects explicit RDD-workflow requests and injects context telling the agent to proceed directly to the requested phase, because RDD research already serves as the brainstorming/exploration step that the superpowers plugin would otherwise intercept for. This is the interim, self-contained fix; the durable fix proposed alongside it is an upstream superpowers rule that an explicitly named workflow request overrides the brainstorm-first default for any plugin with its own exploration phase.
mechanism: interim UserPromptSubmit hook injecting override context, plus a proposed upstream superpowers precedence rule

links.note: the skill activator is implemented as one of ADR-033's UserPromptSubmit hooks.
